# fixture: corner_overhang
# Good die banked into the north-east corner. The naive best placement, (0,6)
# with 50 good die, requires 6 sites of overhang and is illegal (the 200mm
# region must land entirely within the wafer), so it must be rejected in
# favor of (0,4), which has fewer good die (43) but zero overhang. This is
# the fixture that pins down that a higher raw good-die count loses to a
# lower one when the higher count can only be reached with overhang.
# expect: row=0 col=4 good=43 defect=50 overhang=0
